notes: Templates describe checks and artifact expectations by stage type — they are lookup tables, not scripts, and intentionally hold no repeated prompt text. The Stage Runner (scripts/mythos-stage.js) reads the matching template for a stage's 'type' field in projects/meta/project-ledger.json to assemble a Stage Context.

DOCUMENTATION_STAGE.test_strategy: node scripts/project-intelligence.js validate; Markdown link check.

RUNTIME_STAGE.test_strategy: targeted module tests + direct callers; tests/stage4z-test.js and tests/stage3d-test.js baseline comparison for js/**/index.html changes.
security_checks: no unrelated file changes (AGENTS.md §10 scope control)

entry_checks: owner approval gate satisfied where required
INFRASTRUCTURE_STAGE.test_strategy: documentation/config validation only unless stage explicitly authorises live provider verification.
security_checks: no DNS/zone mutation without explicit owner approval
closure_checks: HIGH_RISK lane forbids close --apply mutation; owner must review before merge

expected_artifacts: read-only connector code with credentials sourced from an external secret store, never committed
CONNECTOR_STAGE.test_strategy: targeted connector tests with mocked/sandboxed provider responses; no live external calls in the test suite.
security_checks: no credentials in config or code
read-only enforced at the connector boundary
LEVEL_3 approval boundary respected per docs/AUTOMATION_APPROVAL_MATRIX.md
closure_checks: no live provider credentials present anywhere in the diff

expected_artifacts: draft schema .sql (DRAFT NOT DEPLOYED unless stage explicitly authorises execution)
DATABASE_STAGE.test_strategy: schema-shape validation (table count, balanced parens, no cross-schema FKs, no secret/PII columns); never execute a real migration inside a test.
closure_checks: HIGH_RISK lane forbids close --apply mutation until owner explicitly authorises database execution

SECURITY_STAGE.test_strategy: full targeted security-relevant test suite; explicit isolation/permission-guessing-resistance tests where applicable.
security_checks: no privilege widening without explicit review
closure_checks: HIGH_RISK lane forbids close --apply mutation; owner review required before merge

RESEARCH_STAGE.test_strategy: node scripts/project-intelligence.js validate; Markdown link check. No provider account, no runtime code.
security_checks: no provider credentials of any kind
closure_checks: explicit confirmation the stage stayed documentation-only if that was its declared scope
